description: Submit upscale work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery.

inputSchema.description: Upscale one image from an upload, a public HTTPS image URL, or one owned Image/Edit result. Select exactly one source type.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_rights.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

files.description: Optional upload parts (max 20 MiB total). Use audio for Voice, file for Edit/Upscale, image_upload/last_image_upload/voice_upload/music_upload for Video.

generated_request_id.description: Owned completed source request UUID; required with source_type=generated.

generated_service.description: For generated input: image or edit. Omission defaults to image.

generated_variant.description: For generated input: image uses base/nsfw; edit uses result.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

source_type.description: Choose an uploaded source or a previous generated image.

source_url.description: For source_type=url only: a public HTTPS image URL, max 2048 characters; no credentials, IP literals, non-443 ports or private network destinations.

uploads.description: Private uploaded file references from asset_upload or the web file library. No local paths, URLs or base64 in plans. Set the corresponding source/image/voice/music mode to upload.

name: upscale_create
title: Upscale image
